# Generalized Eigenvalues and Vectors

![Generalized Eigenvalues and Vectors function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/linear-algebra/35-generalized_eigenvalues_vectors.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Generalized right eigenproblem A*v=lambda*B*v with statically CDB values/vectors. output_option 0 values only,1 plus vectors default. Uses a matrix-pair solver, preserving infinite/indeterminate eigenvalue diagnostics without unsafe inverse(B). Inputs calculate in DBL/CDB with explicit numeric promotion; 64-bit integers above 2^53 may round. No broadcasting, no private Matrix reinterpretation. error is I32 and never an automatic dialog. Optional unwired defaults: output_option=1.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Generalized Eigenvalues and Vectors**

Résout A·v=λ·B·v directement sur la paire. Les sorties restent CDB ; les valeurs infinies ou indéterminées sont diagnostiquées sans former inverse(B)·A. Valeurs facultatives non câblées : output_option=1.

</details>
